note: The fuzzer-controlled byte buffer is accepted as the candidate input when it is non-empty.
The raw input bytes are forwarded unchanged into Hermes bytecode detection.
Hermes constructs an ArrayRef directly from the caller-provided pointer and length; the safety obligation is that the buffer must be large enough for the bytecode probe to read the bytes it inspects.
The bytecode-stream probe dereferences the supplied ArrayRef and can read past the end of the one-byte input, triggering the reported heap-buffer-overflow read.
